title: 第2256章 老夫一直醒着的第2255章 偷挖灵药
content_zh:
洛云汐蹲在一旁，看着他行云流水的动作，不由得瞪大了眼睛。
“你怎么懂这么多？”她忍不住问道。
“多看书。”叶无尘随口说道，将赤焰灵芝收入储物戒中。
洛云汐撇了撇嘴，显然对这个回答不太满意，但也没有多说什么，安静站在一旁看着叶无尘采摘灵药。
“你注意点，别一直摘同一个地方的灵药，这样容易被看出来。”
“别说话，我当然知道。”
“你知道还一直摘同一个地方的灵药。”
月夜下，洛云汐在一旁放哨，而叶无尘则是蹲在地上默默地采摘灵药。
直到一个时辰后，两人觉得摘得差不多了，叶无尘这才停下动手，压低声音道：“差不多了，走吧。”
洛云汐点了点头，那双灵动的眸子中闪烁着兴奋的光芒。
两人沿着来时的路，悄无声息地朝灵药园入口走去。
他们的脚步极轻，落地无声，身形在药田间穿梭，如同一道淡淡的影子，融入了夜色之中。
灵药园入口处，那棵古树下，白发苍苍的老者依旧盘膝而坐，双眼微闭，呼吸均匀，似乎还在沉睡之中。
洛云汐看了那老者一眼，嘴角微微上扬，露出一抹得意的笑容，朝叶无尘使了个眼色，那意思再明显不过：你看，我说了李叔睡觉雷打不动吧？
叶无尘没有回应，只是加快脚步，朝灵药园外走去。
然而，就在两人的脚步即将跨出灵药园大门的瞬间，一道苍老的声音忽然在夜色中响起。
“小云汐，这么晚了，你来灵药园做什么？”
那声音不大，甚至可以说是很轻，却如同惊雷一般在两人耳边炸响。
洛云汐的脚步猛然一顿，脸上的笑容瞬间僵住，整个人像是被施了定身术一般，僵在原地一动不动。
叶无尘同样停下了脚步，心中暗暗叹了口气。

他就知道，事情不会这么顺利。
古树下，那名白发苍苍的老者缓缓睁开了眼睛，他的目光落在洛云汐身上，又扫了眼叶无尘。
“李……李叔……”洛云汐转过身来，脸上的表情有些不自然，干笑了两声，声音中带着几分心虚，“您……您怎么醒了？”
“老夫一直醒着的。”老者淡淡开口，声音依旧平静，“从未睡过。”
洛云汐的笑容更加僵硬了，她下意识地退后半步，躲到了叶无尘身后，只露出半个脑袋，那双灵动的眸子中满是心虚。
“李叔，那个……我们就是来灵药园散散步，欣赏一下夜景，没什么别的事。”她的声音越来越小，越来越没有底气，“您继续睡，我们就不打扰您了……”
说着，她拉着叶无尘的袖子，就要往外走。
“站住。”
老者的声音再次响起，洛云汐的脚步再次顿住，她咬着嘴唇，脸上的表情像是在做最后的挣扎。
“小云汐，将你们偷摘的灵药交出来吧。”老者缓缓开口，洛云汐的脸色彻底垮了下来，她知道瞒不住了，索性不再躲藏，从叶无尘身后走了出来，垂头丧气地站在那里，像是做错事被抓住的孩子。
content_en:
Luo Yunxi squatted aside, watching his flowing movements, and couldn't help but widen her eyes.
"How do you know so much?" she couldn't help but ask.
"Read more books." Ye Wuchen said casually and put the Red Flame Ganoderma into the storage ring.
Luo Yunxi curled her lips, obviously not satisfied with this answer, but she didn't say anything more and stood quietly watching Ye Wuchen pick the elixir.
"Be careful, don't keep picking elixirs from the same place, it's easy to be seen."
"Don't talk, of course I know."
"You know you keep picking elixirs from the same place."
Under the moonlit night, Luo Yunxi was standing guard, while Ye Wuchen was squatting on the ground silently picking the elixir.
It wasn't until an hour later that the two of them felt that they had almost picked it. Ye Wuchen stopped and lowered his voice and said, "It's almost done. Let's go."
Luo Yunxi nodded, her smart eyes shining with excitement.
The two of them walked quietly towards the entrance of the Spiritual Medicine Garden along the way they came.
Their footsteps were extremely light and they landed silently. Their figures shuttled through the medicinal fields, blending into the night like a faint shadow.
At the entrance of the elixir garden, under the ancient tree, the white-haired old man was still sitting cross-legged, his eyes slightly closed, breathing evenly, as if he was still sleeping.
Luo Yunxi glanced at the old man, raised the corners of her mouth slightly, showed a proud smile, and winked at Ye Wuchen. The meaning was obvious: Look, I said that Uncle Li can't be beaten while sleeping, right?
Ye Wuchen didn't respond, but just quickened his pace and walked towards the outside of the elixir garden.
However, just as the two of them were about to step out of the gate of the Spiritual Medicine Garden, an old voice suddenly sounded in the night.
"Xiao Yunxi, it's so late, what are you doing in the elixir garden?"
The sound was not loud, it could even be said to be very light, but it was like thunder exploding in their ears.
Luo Yunxi's steps suddenly stopped, and the smile on her face froze instantly. Her whole body seemed to have been cast a restraining spell, and she was frozen in place.
Ye Wuchen also stopped and sighed secretly.
He knew that things would not go so smoothly.
Under the ancient tree, the white-haired old man slowly opened his eyes. His gaze fell on Luo Yunxi, and then glanced at Ye Wuchen.
"Li...Uncle Li..." Luo Yunxi turned around, with an unnatural expression on her face, and laughed twice, with a hint of guilt in her voice, "You...why are you awake?"
"I've always been awake." The old man said calmly, his voice still calm, "I've never slept."
Luo Yunxi's smile became even stiffer. She subconsciously stepped back half a step and hid behind Ye Wuchen. Only half of her head was exposed, and her smart eyes were full of guilt.
"Uncle Li, um... we just came to the Spiritual Medicine Garden to take a walk and enjoy the night view. Nothing else." Her voice became smaller and smaller, and she became less and less confident. "You continue to sleep, and we won't disturb you..."
With that said, she pulled Ye Wuchen's sleeve and was about to walk out.
"Stop."
The old man's voice sounded again, and Luo Yunxi's footsteps paused again. She bit her lip, with an expression on her face as if she was making a final struggle.
"Xiao Yunxi, hand over the elixir you stole." The old man spoke slowly, and Luo Yunxi's face completely fell. She knew she couldn't hide it anymore, so she simply stopped hiding and walked out from behind Ye Wuchen, standing there dejectedly, like a child who had been caught doing something wrong.
